## Change
Explain the user-visible result and why this is the smallest appropriate change.

## Evidence
List commands actually run, native/manual checks, and failures or untested platforms. Distinguish fixtures from live Hermes execution.

## Compatibility and risk
Note changed upstream contracts, permissions, lifecycle or plugin behavior. Link focused independent review for security-sensitive changes.

## Assistance and review
Disclose material AI assistance and the status of human review. Do not imply approval, understanding or testing that did not occur.
